kimage {{ .Chart.AppVersion }} is installed in {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

Components are pulled from {{ .Values.images.repository }} by immutable digest.
No executable payloads or image layers are uploaded through the Kubernetes API.

Apply an Image and a workload using platform://namespace/name:^1.2.0.
Automatic Images default to consumer demand; workloads select native platforms.

Documentation: https://kimage.dev/docs/
Helm uninstall retains registry storage, Image resources, releases, and shared CRDs.
